import itertools

n = 5
nums = list(range(n))
solutions = []
for perm in itertools.permutations(nums):
    diffs = [abs(perm[i] - perm[i+1]) for i in range(n-1)]
    if sorted(diffs) == list(range(1, n)):
        solutions.append(perm)
        
print('Number of solutions:', len(solutions))
for sol in solutions:
    print(sol)
